title: Carried Through Every Season
story:
An elderly man sat on the front porch with his grandson.

The boy pointed to an old walking stick leaning against the wall.

“Grandpa, why do you still keep that old stick?” he asked.

The grandfather smiled.

“This stick has been with me for many years.

It helped me climb mountains when I was young.

It supported me through difficult paths.

And now, in my old age, it still helps me walk.”

The boy held the stick and realized it had been faithful through every season.

God's care is even greater.

He does not help us only when we are young or strong.

He carries us from the beginning of life until the very end.

His love never grows old.

His strength never fails.

The same God who cared for us yesterday will faithfully carry us tomorrow.
life_lesson: God faithfully carries His children through every stage of life. His care never ends.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for carrying me throughout my life.

Thank You that Your love never changes and Your strength never fails.

Help me to trust You in every season, whether I feel strong or weak.

May I always rest in Your faithful care.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Can you remember times when God carried you through difficult seasons?

How does His promise to remain with you throughout your life strengthen your faith?

What concern can you confidently place into His hands today?
verse: Even to your old age and gray hairs I am He, I am He who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you.
